segment_contamination_dimensions: Portable Kitchen sibling (MCAT 135704) targets buyers seeking a standalone portable cooking appliance or mobile kitchen equipment unit — not a cabin structure; names implying a non-cabin portable kitchen appliance are excluded to prevent cross-segment contamination.

Prefabricated Cabin (MCAT 135712) and Modular Portable Cabin (MCAT 165827) are generic cabin siblings covering all use-cases; names that omit the pantry/canteen/kitchen function and read as generic portable cabins are excluded to prevent buyer misdirection into those broader MCATs.

Container Conversion Service (MCAT 119140) targets buyers seeking a conversion service rather than a ready-to-install cabin unit; names framing the product as a container conversion service are excluded.
